# lcd.isConfiguring

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 26.1.0</span></div>

Check if the window is configuring or not.

```lua
local configuring = lcd.isConfiguring()
```

## Parameters

None.

## Returns

configuring (boolean)

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"

```
